title: President Murmu — 4 years in office; new initiatives
summary: Completed 4 yrs as India's 15th President (1st tribal Head of State), Jul 25, 2026.

items: Completed 4 yrs as India's 15th President (1st tribal Head of State), Jul 25, 2026.
Launched: e-Audio Guide, e-Upahaar (3rd ed.), 'Bachpan Bal Parisar', 'RAAHI' e-bus.
Also: presents Sant Kabir & National Handloom Awards 2025 (22 awards); approves 78 gallantry awards; confers Sangeet Natak Akademi Fellowships/Awards (see Section 7).

blocks.content: 🎯 Exam Angle → RAAHI full form; Murmu = India's 1st tribal President.
